integration_issues.flow: Step 7 Import from URL — ownership check (NOT a bug, documentation only)
integration_issues.issue: When the logged-in user does NOT own the decision, POST /api/decisions/{id}/import-actuals-from-url returns 404 'Decision not found' (per _get_decision in routes/matrix_import.py:28-32). The Step 7 page still loads because GET /api/decisions/{id} is permissive, but the import call is owner-gated. During testing, veales hit 404 on a decision that may have been owned by harden_1777921741. The UI handles this gracefully with the 'Import failed — Decision not found' modal. The happy-path was verified separately in pytest with a freshly-created veales-owned decision returning 200.
